objects.name: garden bench
objects.caption: A wooden garden bench with slatted backrest and seat, made of weathered light-brown timber; it has armrests and four straight legs, positioned on a stone patio with its left side partially shaded by foliage.

objects.name: folding chair
objects.caption: A wooden folding chair with vertical slats on the backrest and horizontal slats on the seat, constructed from light-colored weathered wood; it stands upright on four splayed legs, placed beside the table on the patio.

objects.name: dining table
objects.caption: A rectangular outdoor dining table with a slatted top made of light-colored wood (likely teak or similar), supported by four straight legs connected by an X-shaped cross-brace understructure; it sits centrally on the paved patio, casting a soft shadow.

objects.name: lounge chair
objects.caption: A metal-framed reclining lounge chair with beige fabric sling seat and back, featuring a padded cylindrical headrest pillow; the frame is silver-gray aluminum with a folding mechanism, positioned at an angle on the grass near potted plants.

objects.name: folding chair
objects.caption: A second wooden folding chair identical in design to index 1—slatted back and seat, light-weathered wood, four splayed legs—placed opposite the bench across the table, slightly angled toward the center.
